items.description: Editorial 12.00 release. Rebuilt from complete canonical sources with the unified two-Slot multiclass model across Awakened and Sleeping characters, the Sleeping Dormant Domain, and corrected navigation. This is the authoritative downloadable Corebook for the current portal release.
